subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should Reef relay REST requests fail after a fixed 15-second pre-header deadline for all existing deployments?
rationale: A deadline is necessary to preserve reconnect progress, but selecting 15 seconds changes existing compatibility behavior and no documented Reef contract establishes that exact budget.

options.title: Approve the 15-second deadline
options.body: Keep the proven fixed deadline after removing the daemon regression, accepting that relays taking longer than 15 seconds to return headers will enter reconnect handling.

options.title: Choose a longer fixed deadline
options.body: Retain the same shared timeout design but use an owner-selected budget, such as the existing 30-second Reef WebSocket handshake deadline, to reduce upgrade sensitivity.

options.title: Pause for relay contract data
options.body: Hold the PR until supported relay latency expectations or production observations establish a safe fixed request budget.

recommendation.title: Approve the 15-second deadline
recommendation.body: Keep the proven fixed deadline after removing the daemon regression, accepting that relays taking longer than 15 seconds to return headers will enter reconnect handling.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and proved the exact Reef relay request path on current main.
